reviews.text: My dog ​​was vomiting and trembling, so I took him to this clinic, which was open early in the morning, for an examination. The ultrasound and palpation showed no abnormalities? Despite a high fever of 39.5°C, they didn't provide a proper examination. They said something like, "We can do blood tests and ultrasounds if you want?" Isn't it up to you, the doctor, to decide that? We were sent home with just an anti-nausea IV drip. Even after returning home, the trembling wouldn't stop, so I took him to my regular vet, where the same ultrasound examination revealed abnormalities in his stomach and intestines. Because of his high fever, they also did a blood test. His inflammation levels were nine times higher than normal, and if I hadn't taken him to my regular vet and had just waited, he wouldn't be alive today. Also, charging nearly 7000 yen for an abdominal ultrasound is a rip-off. I've never seen such an expensive ultrasound before. Even my regular vet laughed at how expensive it was. Are the positive reviews fake? I think this is a hospital that only cares about its regulars. I will never go there again.
I've been there several times because they're open first thing in the morning. I think the doctor is good; thorough and efficient.
I went there with high expectations after reading the reviews, but the teacher seemed unmotivated (lol). What a shame...

This is a courteous, sincere, and trustworthy clinic.

They are very attentive to the feelings of pet owners who tend to be anxious, and instead of simply saying, "It's okay because they're energetic" or "It's okay because they have a good appetite," they offer various possibilities for addressing concerns.

Even when there are no particular problems, they speak gently to the dogs, saying things like, "You just came to show us your cute face today," or "No injections today," which dispels any anxiety or hesitation about whether it's okay to bring them in for a checkup.

All the staff are very kind and pleasant, and the clinic is clean. My dogs aren't scared at all when they're on the examination table. I would like to continue using their services for a long time to come.

The vet treats my cat with great care.
They explain the treatment plan and other details clearly, even to a layperson, which is reassuring.
The staff are also very kind and helpful.
My cat knows they'll be gentle with her and doesn't mind going to this hospital.
I will definitely use this hospital again if I need to take my cat there in the future.
Thank you.

I am so grateful to the doctor and staff for their kindness and attentiveness. I'm sure my Shiba Inu is happy in heaven to have met such a wonderful doctor in the end! Thank you so much for everything.

Despite visiting the vet three times with the same symptoms, the abnormality was overlooked.

[First Visit]
I showed the vet a video of my dog ​​intensely scratching its muzzle and consulted them. I was told there was nothing wrong with the muzzle itself, and only an anti-itch cream was prescribed.

[Second Visit]
Since the symptoms hadn't improved at all, I visited again, but again I was told there was "no problem" and only an anti-itch cream was prescribed.

[Third Visit]
I explained that the itching wasn't in the muzzle, but rather "swollen gums inside the mouth," and the vet examined my dog's mouth, but again I was told there was "no particular problem."

However, within a week of that, when I took my dog ​​for grooming, the groomer told me, "The gums at the back of the mouth are severely swollen and inflamed. You should go to the vet immediately."

Honestly, I have strong doubts and distrust as to why this swelling wasn't noticed despite three visits.

If it had been noticed two months ago, I think it wouldn't have gotten this bad, and I could have made things much easier for my beloved dog.
I'm very shocked and regretful.

I have an appointment at another hospital tomorrow, but I've been told that surgery is a high possibility depending on the situation.

Despite consulting with vets many times before, I was repeatedly told "nothing is wrong," and this is the result.

Everyone, especially the doctor, is incredibly kind.

The clinic is also very clean and well-maintained.

When I first got my dog, I was struggling to decide which animal hospital to take him to, so I asked around to many pet owners. Everyone unanimously recommended this doctor, and we've been going there ever since.

I believe choosing the right doctor from puppyhood is extremely important. (Choosing a hospital for people is difficult, isn't it?)
I highly recommend this doctor; he's truly excellent.

We look forward to continuing our relationship with you.
I wouldn't even give it one star.

They examine you carefully.
Since you can make an appointment, the waiting time is short, which is great!

The nurses are also kind and gentle.

Although I've only been coming here for a few months, I can already feel the depth of the doctor's experience and knowledge. They explain things thoroughly and listen carefully to my treatment preferences, making it easy to answer questions.

My cat, who is usually afraid of men, isn't scared at all. Everyone, including the nurses, is kind and attentive.

Thank you for referring me to a secondary medical institution when further examinations were necessary.

A dentist specializing in stomatitis comes from another prefecture every other month (the frequency may have changed now), and I received treatment from them. Thank you for the overnight hospitalization after the surgery.

My home is a bit far, but I would like to continue receiving care here whenever I'm feeling unwell.
My workplace is nearby, making it easy to take my dog ​​there, so I requested rabies and combination vaccinations. …

Five stars is not enough.
Thank you for your continued support. My previous clinic was suddenly closed due to the director's sudden illness, and I was at a loss when I found you and came …
The teacher was so kind, I would love to bring my child there again!
We always rely on your care for our two dogs, Bri-chan and Scott-chan. I trust the doctor and staff so much that five stars just doesn't do them justice. …

This is the worst hospital. My small dog was bitten by a larger dog on a morning walk. This hospital is open from 8:00, so I arrived at 7:50 for an emergency, but they waited until 8:30 and still didn't call me. I was so annoyed that it was an emergency and I had to say "I've had enough" and left.

I visited because my dog ​​had lost his appetite and was vomiting.

He's a small 4-month-old puppy that I adopted just a week ago, so I was worried …
These vets are the best in north west Osaka. Fix your cat up so good!
